deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page, and it is almost certainly not in Riemann's hand or by him. It is an editorial work note headed 'Druck der Abhandlg. v. Riemann ü. d. trig. Rh.' (printing of Riemann's paper on trigonometric series). It concerns a reprint of the Habilitationsschrift 'Über die Darstellbarkeit einer Function durch eine trigonometrische Reihe'. That paper was first published posthumously by R. Dedekind in Abh. d. Kgl. Ges. d. Wiss. zu Göttingen 13 (1867), pp. 87-132. The page numbers cited (S. 87, 89, 96, 104) fit that 1867 printing. The note most likely belongs to the preparation of Riemann's Gesammelte Werke (ed. H. Weber with Dedekind, 1876), where the paper was reprinted.

Item by item:
(a) 'Titelblatt. "Aus dem Nachlass - R. Dedekind" kann wegfallen.' The separate title page of the 1867 printing ('Aus dem Nachlasse des Verfassers mitgetheilt durch R. Dedekind') can be dropped.
(b) 'Inhaltsverzeichniss?' Should a table of contents be added?
(c) 'S. 87. Am Anfang "diese Abhandlung - R. Dedekind" nur als Note ... durch R. Dedekind *)'. Dedekind's prefatory remark at the start of p. 87 should appear only as a footnote (*) signed by Dedekind. This remark explains that the paper was submitted in 1854 as the Habilitationsschrift.
(d) 'S. 89. Formel besser! - Citat 2)!' On p. 89 (the historical part, on the vibrating-string controversy) a formula should be typeset better and a citation, footnote 2, fixed or added.
(e) 'S. 96 reicht bis "... in allen Fällen entschieden würde."' Records where a page of the original manuscript ends relative to p. 96 of the print.
(f) 'S. 104 reicht bis "diesen Werthen unendlich genähert werden." (S. 23 d. Origin. Ende von Art. 5)'. Print p. 104 ends at that phrase, which corresponds to manuscript p. 23, the end of Article 5. Article 5 belongs to the section on the concept of the definite integral and its scope.

The editor is thus collating the 1867 print against Riemann's original manuscript. The previous folio fits this reading: it lists critical questions on pages of the manuscript or print, e.g. whether lambda''(x) is assumed integrable, and the derivative of sin(k tau)/sin(tau).

results.what: Editorial instructions for reprinting Riemann's 1854/1867 Habilitationsschrift on trigonometric series: drop the title page, possibly add a table of contents, move Dedekind's preface into a footnote, improve a formula and a citation on p. 89, and map print pages 96 and 104 to manuscript pages (p. 104 = end of Art. 5 = original p. 23).
results.modern_name: Editorial/collation note for Riemann's Gesammelte Werke (1876)
results.usually_credited_to: H. Weber and R. Dedekind (editors of Riemann's Werke)

deep.surprise_reason: The page holds no mathematics and is not Riemann's own work. It is a routine editorial note, probably by Weber or Dedekind, about reprinting the 1867 Göttingen edition of the trigonometric-series paper. It matches the known publication history.
transcription_corrections: Line 4: 'nur d. Note z' is probably 'nur als Note zu ...' (i.e. keep only as a footnote by R. Dedekind *)); the abbreviation is unclear.
Line 2: 'Aus dem Nachlass' matches the 1867 title phrase 'Aus dem Nachlasse des Verfassers mitgetheilt durch R. Dedekind'.
Line 7: 'reicht bis' reading is plausible (marking page correspondence); 'S. 96' and 'S. 104' refer to the pagination of Abh. Ges. Wiss. Göttingen 13 (1867).
Line 8: '(S. 23 d. Origin. Ende von Art. 5)' should be read as 'S. 23 des Originals (manuscript), end of Article 5'.
